title: Bad Luck Island
statementMd:
The Bad Luck Island is inhabited by three kinds of species: $*r*$ rocks, $*s*$ scissors and $*p*$ papers. At some moments of time two random individuals meet (all pairs of individuals can meet equiprobably), and if they belong to different species, then one individual kills the other one: a rock kills scissors, scissors kill paper, and paper kills a rock. Your task is to determine for each species what is the probability that this species will be the only one to inhabit this island after a long enough period of time.

## Input

The single line contains three integers $*r*$, $*s*$ and $*p*$ ($1 ≤ *r*, *s*, *p* ≤ 100$) — the original number of individuals in the species of rock, scissors and paper, respectively.

## Output

Print three space-separated real numbers: the probabilities, at which the rocks, the scissors and the paper will be the only surviving species, respectively. The answer will be considered correct if the relative or absolute error of each number doesn't exceed $10^{ - 9}$.
statementZhMd:
厄运岛上生活着三种物种：$*r*$ 个石头、$*s*$ 个剪刀和 $*p*$ 个纸。在某些时刻，两个随机个体会相遇（所有个体对相遇的概率均相等）。如果它们属于不同物种，那么其中一个个体会杀死另一个个体：石头杀死剪刀，剪刀杀死纸，纸杀死石头。你的任务是确定对于每个物种，在经过足够长的时间后，该物种成为岛上唯一生存物种的概率。

## 输入格式

一行包含三个整数 $*r*$、$*s*$ 和 $*p*$（$1 ≤ *r*, *s*, *p* ≤ 100$），分别表示最初石头、剪刀和纸这三种物种的个体数量。

## 输出格式

输出三个以空格分隔的实数，分别表示石头、剪刀和纸成为唯一生存物种的概率。如果每个数的相对误差或绝对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则答案将被视为正确。
